answer: Graded work pays from escrow, and the escrow opens only when three reviewers from separate subnetworks sign off. A panel drawn from one cluster voids the payout. Rewards then vest over 100 epochs, so nothing cashes out on day one. The velvet rope is the juror draw. Two hundred fake accounts need 200 independent panels, each holding stake locked through the vest. Crystal clear replay logs expose every draw after the fact. A farm that cannot fill those panels gets no harbor.
